findings.fact: North holds C4 and leads toward South's CAJ6; North retains HA and three winning diamonds, while South retains D54.
findings.explanation: The club lead permits winning CA and returning to dummy through diamonds. It preserves a concrete route to the contract without requiring an assumed defender holding.
quotes: Lead the lowest club toward South’s ace-jack, preserving dummy’s higher club spots.

findings.fact: Declarer has three tricks, CA, three winning diamonds in North, and three heart tricks. South can win CA now and lead D4 or D5 to dummy.
